title: GARAGE (rover customising)
height: walls 4.6 m, dome rising 1.3 m; the whole room is pumped empty of air before the big door opens
items: ROVER PARTS RACK (wheels, battery packs, hold boxes)
notes: Owner, 2026-10-07: the old garage split in two; this one is for customising the rovers; three normal sealing doors into the base and one big outside door; the room can be pumped empty of air (seal the inner doors, pump down, open the big door, and back).

Rover measured in the game: 1.73 m wide, 3.10 m long, 1.66 m tall (rover.glb bounds); wheelbase 1.69 m, gauge 1.42 m, steering up to 40 degrees (rover.gd), so it turns in about a 2.0 m radius. Big door 5 x 4 m: 1.6 m clear each side of the rover, 2.3 m over it with a suited driver (about 2.4 m tall seated).

Size 14 x 12 m, corners 3.0 m: coordinator's pick (owner may change): the old 12 x 10 garage with a door spot in each side wall needs 2 m more each way to keep wall room beside the doors. Flat floor (no ledges or dais): the rover drives on it.
